The helper materializes and executes there (`implementation/worksite_command_helper.ts:575–623,705–715,1360–1428`). `constructWorksiteExecutionObservation` explicitly requires `helperArtifact.snapshotRoot === helperPlan.sandboxRoot` at line 2024; the retained provenance's plan is revalidated against its task at line 2107. These are existing owner coordinates, not proposed fields.

- Output root: `final-native-setup-03/resources/archives/worksite-command-execution/b093bf328f4e9fa00123ac6d3d9e17b3c13ce39f5010cbf9107da040c2e301fa/15503e8e731b79ad04f5efec94faa5d3324c6e908dfabd9fc7eaed638a52124e/sandbox`.
